script_text: Stop! Taurus, the earthy skies are aligning to shift your inner world outward. Saturn is forming a sextile to your ruling planet Venus, linking your 12th House of the Subconscious with your 3rd House of Communication. This harmonious aspect brings deep insights that can be voiced with confidence, especially in matters of the heart. In love, expect a stimulating conversation with someone nearby—a neighbor, a sibling, or a coworker—that could spark a flirtatious connection if you're single, or renew intimacy through honest dialogue if you're taken. Career-wise, your disciplined behind‑the‑scenes efforts are about to be recognized; a clear, well‑structured proposal presented now may lead to a steady raise or a new contract tied to your practical skills. Warning: avoid letting old resentments resurface; instead, let this transit grant you an unexpected financial blessing from a forgotten source. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
